none: PAS DENO-220EF6: Copper alloy tubular bead
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Iron Age cast copper alloy fitting. Cylinder, split lengthways, moulded decoration of three transverse rides (one at either end, one at centre) with two transverse pointed ovals between. Length 13.9mm, diameter 7.2mm, thickness of metal 0.7-0.9mm, weight 1.49g. Put through the Treasure process as originally thought to be gold. The Treasure report reads: The find consists of a short metal tube…
